correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated every disconnected three-subset for n=3..14; counts 0 for 3..8 and (9,30,66,112,169,238) for 9..14. Read both actual shelling CSV blobs at assigned source tree and independently verified they are complete, duplicate-free, and satisfy the shelling ridge-coverage criterion for every earlier facet; count of spanning facets 1 at 13 and 8 at 14. Independently enumerated all faces and reduced F2 boundary matrices at n9..12, finding beta_3=1,beta_4=11,beta_5=1,beta_7=2 respectively, each below pure dimension n-4, obstructing shellability. The infinite tail n>=15 is Theorem 1.4 of Chauhan–Shukla (2026), not extrapolation; sphere counts specialize to the displayed expression. F2 finite homology cannot determine all integral homology below threshold, and no such claim is made.
